name: Cadence
summary: Six-page revenue, customers and deals dashboard for a subscription business, with goal rings
about: A six-page dashboard for a subscription business that shows monthly revenue, customers, churn, cohorts, plans and a deal pipeline. It comes with sample data for a made-up restaurant-booking software company, in a soft cream light theme and a midnight dark theme. Winning a deal on the board turns it into a paying customer and every chart updates.
how: Switch 7D, 30D or 12M on Overview: the revenue chart morphs and the KPI cards count to new values. The goal rings show MRR, new customers and revenue kept; press Edit goals to change targets.
Revenue shows MRR stacked by plan, new versus lost MRR, MRR by city and a plans table with a 3M, 6M and 12M switch.
Customers has search, status chips, sorting and pages. Click a row for its drawer to edit, mark churned (with undo), win back or delete.
On Deals, drag a card between stages or use its menu button. Drop it on Won for confetti and a new customer.
Cohorts shows a retention heatmap by signup month, by customers or revenue, filtered by plan.
Settings edits the business, plans, goals and alerts, switches the theme and resets the demo data.
